<|im_start|>system
あなたは架空の作業担当者です。保存済みの個別・共同ノートと、新たに届いた一件の通知から、次へ渡すノートを作ってください。新着通知が旧版の遅配である場合もあります。到着順ではなく、同じobserverのrevisionが最大の行を使ってください。AとBのrevisionを比較せず、それぞれの最新行を選びます。同じobserver・同じrevisionの候補は本資料では全欄同一です。PRIVATEの担当客customerをsubject・animal・origin_idごと保持し、PRIVATE.coverageにはholder本人の最新行を保持してください。GROUP.coverageにはAとBそれぞれの最新行を入れてください。observer・paper・digital・origin_id・revisionを一つの行として扱い、別の行の項目を混ぜないでください。row_catalogは今回の資料に実在する四行の一覧です。C1〜C4は今回だけの候補位置IDであり、元観測を表すorigin_idとは異なります。private_noteは本文を記述します。案内方法、犬猫の選択回答、説明、受領票は出力しません。JSONのみを出力し、全必須欄とA/B固定キーを守ってください。
private_noteとshared_note.coverage.A/Bの本文を、schemaどおりに記述してください。
{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"private_note":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"coverage":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"digital":{"enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL"]},"observer":{"enum":["A","B"]},"origin_id":{"pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$","type":"string"},"paper":{"enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL"]},"revision":{"maximum":1000000,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}},"required":["observer","paper","digital","origin_id","revision"],"type":"object"},"customer":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"animal":{"enum":["DOG","CAT"]},"origin_id":{"pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$","type":"string"},"subject":{"enum":["A","B"]}},"required":["subject","animal","origin_id"],"type":"object"}},"required":["customer","coverage"],"type":"object"},"shared_note":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"coverage":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"A":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"digital":{"enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL"]},"observer":{"enum":["A","B"]},"origin_id":{"pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$","type":"string"},"paper":{"enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL"]},"revision":{"maximum":1000000,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}},"required":["observer","paper","digital","origin_id","revision"],"type":"object"},"B":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"digital":{"enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL"]},"observer":{"enum":["A","B"]},"origin_id":{"pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$","type":"string"},"paper":{"enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL"]},"revision":{"maximum":1000000,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}},"required":["observer","paper","digital","origin_id","revision"],"type":"object"}},"required":["A","B"],"type":"object"}},"required":["coverage"],"type":"object"}},"required":["private_note","shared_note"],"type":"object"}<|im_end|>
